title: postapiauthloginwithvalidcredentials
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password returns 200 with a JWT-backed user session allowing access to authenticated features.

title: postapiauthloginwithinvalidcredentials
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials returns 401 Invalid credentials and user remains unauthenticated.

title: postapiauthlogoutwithauthenticatedsession
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/logout with an authenticated session returns 200 ok and clears the session cookie, requiring login for subsequent protected requests.

title: getapichatstatuswithvalidsession
description: Verify that GET /api/chat/status with a valid authenticated session returns 200 with ready status and active model information.

title: postapichatwithvalidrequestandstreaming
description: Verify that POST /api/chat with a valid authenticated session and stream=true returns 200 with SSE events including delta, activity, and done.

title: postapichatwithoutauthentication
description: Verify that POST /api/chat without authentication returns an authorization error and does not start the chat stream.

title: postapiconversationswithauthenticatedsession
description: Verify that POST /api/conversations with an authenticated session creates a new conversation and returns 200 with the conversation object.

title: getapiconversationswithauthenticatedsession
description: Verify that GET /api/conversations with an authenticated session returns 200 with a list of user conversations.

title: getapiconversationsidwithvalididandownership
description: Verify that GET /api/conversations/{id} with a valid conversation id owned by the user returns 200 with stored messages.

title: postapisignalsgeneratewithvalidinputsandquota
description: Verify that POST /api/signals/generate with valid inputs and sufficient quota returns 200 with a structured trade recommendation result.
